scope: Raska’s original Basin Camp, stock Greyhollow context, Basin Well Road and north Spanwater, at both authored overworld lenses; no claim for Ilyra’s south side, optional encounters, tactical assets or device performance.
author: Torn Asunder Raska environment and campaign integration author
reviewer: Independent Torn Asunder overworld release reviewer

evidence.godot_context: Godot 4.7.2 Compatibility; eight 960 × 540 near/regional views from actual normal title Load with separate Raska profiles. Eight normalized final frames match the independently reviewed site captures byte for byte.
evidence.close_up: Grounded Basin perimeter and weathered operations hardstand; existing Mine in neutral after-rescue framing; contrasting Well Road yards; stepped, dry north retaining works and worn track.
evidence.motion: Local troops follow exact portal approach curves. Named sector transfer is a distinct save-first operation. The new remote horizon is decorative, not terrain that can be traveled.
evidence.reproduction: Run tests/raska_normal_overworld.gd after project import. The linked native release workflow exercises actual Load, Y/A, persisted travel, and a rendered Well Road window.
evidence.measurements: 51 native normalized title checks. Basin: 1,401 compound rays and 360 route points. Well: 1,755 context contacts and 800 route points. North: 911 approach support and 162 route/shoulder checks. No target performance claim.
evidence.capture_encoding: Each .jpg.base64 is a lossless text transport of the exact reviewed JPEG, not a changed image. Decode with base64 --decode < capture.jpg.base64 > capture.jpg. The digest below applies to the decoded JPEG; the outer files digest pins the tracked text.

shape_and_craft.finding: Basin enclosure reads as an occupied compound, Well Road’s yards differ in profile, and north terraces bracket the bridge and gate.

materials_and_lighting.finding: Dust, hardstand and gravel fold into native terrain. Near Spanwater stayed byte-identical when the contrasted far horizon was moved behind the actual bank relief.

readability_in_play.finding: Roads and stations remain legible in both zooms; the new layered far bank has no clipped pale wedge. Each site keeps the proper Raska year and mission identity.

motion_and_effects.finding: Grounded local paths and reversible canonical crossings are distinct. The north boundary does not show an Ilyra arrival or prematurely unlock a mission.

integration_and_cost.finding: New visual context is decorative and non-colliding. Actual title fixtures verify the normalized package and reuse the existing profile/mission authority.
